text:
Type: round mirror with walnut frame
Use: wall mirror that adds light and depth; living room, hallway, bedroom, dining room
Style: mid-century modern, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: walnut veneer frame with a fine grain, glass mirror
Colors: warm medium walnut brown, silver mirror
Shape: perfect circle set in a deep curved wooden rim that wraps around the edge like a shallow drum, thin band visible from the front, large and sculptural
Feel: warm, refined, timeless
Goes with: walnut or oak furniture, leather, brass, white walls; mid-century modern or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: STOCKHOLM
product.description: Provided with safety film - reduces damage if glass is broken.
